verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a payments API platform, but the evidence documents only single-item operations. These include one card enrollment via POST /acp/v1/tokens, one purchase intent via POST /acp/v1/instructions, and per-instruction credential retrieval. The agent toolkit's invoice and payment-link management is never described as batch or bulk. With no documented capability to act on many items at once, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
